policies.question: How do I update my payment method?
policies.answer: Sign in, open Settings, select Billing, and choose Update payment method. Save the new details to apply them to future renewals.

policies.question: Why was my subscription renewed?
policies.answer: Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled before the renewal date. The billing page shows the next renewal date.

policies.question: How can I cancel?
policies.answer: Open Settings, select Plan, and choose Cancel subscription. Access normally remains active until the current paid period ends.
